name: Earthquake
source: [spoiler]Formerly known as Tyron Bistwork, a American who was a part of the Mars colonizing project. He was a general expert in machines and AI. He was brainwashed by Shannon though his patch to believe that, for humanity's sake, he had to put them through trials and tribulations.  His power allows him to cause a localized Magnitude 10 earthquake through the activation of the pile bunker on his right arm.[/spoiler]
